question:
The prices, in rupees, of three school supplies are $x$, $y$, and $z$. Three purchase combinations give
$$x+y+z=120$$
$$2x+y+3z=250$$
$$x+3y+2z=250$$

(a) Form the corresponding matrix equation and show that the coefficient matrix is invertible.

(b) Use the inverse-matrix method to determine $x$, $y$, and $z$.

(c) Interpret and verify the obtained prices.
explanation:
(a)
The system has the matrix form
$$AX=B$$
where
$$A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1\\2 & 1 & 3\\1 & 3 & 2\end{bmatrix},\quad X=\begin{bmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}120\\250\\250\end{bmatrix}$$
The determinant is
$$|A|=1(2-9)-1(4-3)+1(6-1)$$
$$|A|=-7-1+5=-3\neq0$$
Therefore, $A$ is invertible.

(b)
The adjoint is
$$\operatorname{adj}A=\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 1 & 2\\-1 & 1 & -1\\5 & -2 & -1\end{bmatrix}$$
Hence,
$$A^{-1}=-\frac{1}{3}\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 1 & 2\\-1 & 1 & -1\\5 & -2 & -1\end{bmatrix}$$
Therefore,
$$X=A^{-1}B$$
$$X=-\frac{1}{3}\begin{bmatrix}-7 & 1 & 2\\-1 & 1 & -1\\5 & -2 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}120\\250\\250\end{bmatrix}$$
$$X=-\frac{1}{3}\begin{bmatrix}-840+250+500\\-120+250-250\\600-500-250\end{bmatrix}$$
$$X=-\frac{1}{3}\begin{bmatrix}-90\\-120\\-150\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}30\\40\\50\end{bmatrix}$$
Thus,
$$x=30,\quad y=40,\quad z=50$$

(c)
The three supplies cost $₹30$, $₹40$, and $₹50$, respectively.
Verification:
$$30+40+50=120$$
$$2(30)+40+3(50)=60+40+150=250$$
$$30+3(40)+2(50)=30+120+100=250$$
Hence, all three purchase equations are satisfied.

options.A:
(a) $|A|=3$, so $A$ is invertible
(b) $(x,y,z)=(30,50,40)$
(c) Only the first equation is satisfied
options.B:
(a) $|A|=-3$, so $A$ is invertible
(b) $(x,y,z)=(40,30,50)$
(c) All three equations are satisfied
options.C:
(a) $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&1&1\\2&1&3\\1&3&2\end{bmatrix}$, $|A|=-3\neq0$
(b) $(x,y,z)=(30,40,50)$
(c) The prices are $₹30$, $₹40$, and $₹50$, and all three purchase equations are satisfied
options.D:
(a) $|A|=0$, so the matrix is singular
(b) The prices are not uniquely determined
(c) $(30,40,50)$ is one of infinitely many possible price sets
